title: Ear sensation logged on blog before the Indian Ocean earthquake

tellings.quote: So that was in September of 03, I believe it was.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, hired him to communicate with aliens, says he would feel a sensation in his ear when a message was coming. He says that around September 2003 he logged one such sensation on his blog, and connects it to a later disaster, the great Indian Ocean earthquake that struck Indonesia, with Japan also part of his account. He wrote about it in a 2006 update to his book Above Black, telling it as a sign the contact was real and could warn of things ahead.
